final:
def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one file name with no path separator, drive, or parent reference."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or ":" in name:
        return False
    return True

def count_nonempty(texts: list[str]) -> int:
    """Number of texts that are not empty."""
    post out >= 0 and out <= texts.len()
    ex count_nonempty(["a", "", "b"]) == 2
    ex count_nonempty([]) == 0
    n = 0
    for t in texts:
        if t != "":
            n += 1
    return n

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file name inside the notes directory, or "" when the name is unsafe or the file is missing or unreadable. Reads through fs.sub("notes") so no name can reach outside notes."""
    post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else ""
        return text

def count_readable(names: list[str]) -> int uses fs:
    """Count of names whose file inside the notes directory reads as non-empty text. Missing or unreadable files count as zero."""
    post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
    n = 0
    for name in names:
        if read_note(name) != "":
            n += 1
    return n
